title: The morning
steps: Bright morning light shines through the window. You slept very well in your new bed.
Good morning! Today we go to the library: its wand bank lends a school wand until we buy our own. And I do not have one at all yet!
I need one too! The wand I am carrying is just {friend}'s spare that I borrowed at the gate, and I really want to give it back.
We can go together, then! I know the way to the library.
You walk out of the dormitory and cross into the common room.
You go to the door and step out into the castle's long corridors, ready to find the library.
